requirements.text: [fact] A single left click on a task-pane variable must select and activate that variable without inserting any value into Excel.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 explicitly requires single-left-click activation without insertion.
[conflict][code] src/app/app.html:25 binds click to activateAndInsert, and src/app/app.ts:20-40 both activates the variable and calls ExcelInsertionService.insert.
[conflict][test] src/app/app.spec.ts:30-45 currently asserts that one button click inserts the selected variable.
[fact][knowledge] context-pack.json contains no accepted knowledge that changes this requirement.

requirements.text: [fact] A double click on a task-pane variable must insert the active variable value into the current Excel selection exactly once.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 requires insertion only on double click and identifies the inserted value as the active variable value.
[fact][code] src/app/app.html:19-32 has no dblclick binding; src/app/app.ts:20-40 exposes only the combined activateAndInsert path.

[inference][implementation] Browser double-click dispatch includes click events before dblclick, so separating click activation from dblclick insertion lets the clicked variable become active before one insertion handler runs; focused tests must verify the observable call count and value.
[fact][test] src/app/app.spec.ts has no double-click test.

requirements.text: [fact] The Excel cell context-menu command must continue inserting the active variable value.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 requires context-menu insertion to be preserved.
[fact][code] src/office/commands.ts:10-20 calls insert with mockVariableStore.active.value and always completes the Office command event.
[fact][test] src/office/commands.spec.ts:9-18 verifies insertion of mockVariableStore.active.value and single completion.
[fact][documentation] README.md:61 and README.md:85-86 document the active-variable context-menu flow.

requirements.text: [fact] Insertion must continue filling every cell in both contiguous and discontiguous selected Excel ranges.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 requires multi-range behavior to be preserved.
[fact][code] src/office/excel-insertion.service.ts:25-38 obtains Workbook.getSelectedRanges(), iterates every area, and assigns a value matrix to each range.
[fact][test] src/office/excel-insertion.service.spec.ts:38-80 verifies contiguous multi-cell, single-cell, and discontiguous multi-area writes.
[fact][documentation] README.md:59-60 documents contiguous and discontiguous selection support.

requirements.text: [fact] The changed interaction must preserve accessible task-pane controls, active-state announcement, status feedback, and a keyboard-accessible insertion alternative.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 requires accessibility to be preserved.
[fact][code] src/app/app.html:19-32 uses native buttons and aria-pressed for active state; src/app/app.html:37 uses role=status with aria-live=polite.
[fact][code] src/app/app.html:46-50 exposes context-menu insertion as an alternative path, while src/office/commands.ts:10-20 implements that command.

[inference][acceptance] Because insertion is required only on double click, native button activation by keyboard must remain selection-only; the Excel context-menu command remains the non-double-click insertion path. The Developer and Reviewer must preserve the existing button, aria-pressed, and live-status semantics.

requirements.text: [fact] The shared mock store must continue exposing exactly 10 stable variables and tracking one active variable.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 requires the 10-variable mock store to be preserved.
[fact][code] src/app/variables/mock-variable-store.ts:3-16 creates exactly 10 variables once, and lines 22-37 expose and update the active variable.
[fact][test] src/app/variables/mock-variable-store.spec.ts:4-24 verifies ten unique finite runtime-stable variables and active-variable changes.
[fact][documentation] README.md:3-5 describes the same 10-value runtime lifetime.

requirements.text: [fact] Visible task-pane guidance and repository usage instructions must explain single-click activation, double-click insertion, and context-menu insertion.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 requires visible instructions to be updated.
[conflict][ui] src/app/app.html:5-8 and 45-50 currently say to choose or activate a variable without distinguishing single click from double click.

[conflict][documentation] README.md:59-67 and 81-86 describe select-then-click behavior rather than double-click insertion.

requirements.text: [fact] Focused automated tests must distinguish selection-only single clicks from exactly-once double-click insertion and retain coverage for insertion success, failure, accessibility, multi-range behavior, context-menu insertion, and the 10-variable store.
evidence: [fact][task] User comment e81d9981c8b64aca902c00e1d98e2d78 requires focused tests to be updated while preserving the named behaviors.

[fact][test] src/office/commands.spec.ts, src/office/excel-insertion.service.spec.ts, and src/app/variables/mock-variable-store.spec.ts already cover the preserved command, range, and store behaviors.

summary: [fact] All nine scoped requirements have sufficient first-party evidence for implementation, with no open question or held scope. humanReadable.title: Select variables with one click and insert them with a double click
humanReadable.objective: Change the Angular Excel task pane so one left click only makes a variable active, while double clicking inserts the active value into every currently selected Excel cell. Keep the existing context-menu route, multi-range support, accessible controls, and ten stable mock variables, and update the instructions and tests.

requirements.title: Single click selects only
requirements.description: A single left click changes the active variable and must not write to Excel.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a variable updates the shared active variable.
The clicked button exposes aria-pressed=true.
No insertion service call occurs from a single click.

requirements.title: Double click inserts once
requirements.description: Double clicking a variable inserts the active variable value into the current Excel selection exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: The double-clicked variable is active before insertion.
Exactly one insertion call is made with the active value.
Success and error status messages continue to describe the result.

requirements.title: Context-menu insertion remains available
requirements.description: The Excel cell context-menu command continues to insert whichever mock variable is active.
acceptanceCriteria: The command passes mockVariableStore.active.value to the insertion operation.
The Office command completion callback still runs exactly once on success and failure.

requirements.title: All selected ranges are filled
requirements.description: Insertion continues to fill one cell, a contiguous range, or every area in a discontiguous selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Every cell in each selected range receives the active value.
Reported area and cell counts remain correct.

requirements.title: Accessible state and feedback are preserved
requirements.description: Variable controls remain native buttons with an announced active state and live status feedback; keyboard activation selects without inserting, and Excel's context-menu command remains the insertion alternative.
acceptanceCriteria: Variable controls remain keyboard-focusable native buttons.
aria-pressed tracks the active variable.
The polite live-status region reports activation and insertion outcomes.
The visible guidance includes the context-menu insertion alternative.

requirements.title: Ten stable mock variables remain
requirements.description: The shared runtime store continues to contain exactly ten finite, stable values and one active variable.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly ten unique variables are created.
Values remain stable for the runtime lifetime.
Changing the active variable does not recreate or alter values.

requirements.title: Instructions match the new interaction

acceptanceCriteria: Visible task-pane copy says single click activates and double click inserts.
